name: Card Pack
tagline: Seven classic card games. Hands-free on G2.
description:
Seven classic card games on your G2 smart glasses. Everything happens on the lenses — your hand, the trick in front of you, the score, all visible without picking up your phone.

Trick-taking trio: Hearts (avoid hearts and the Queen of Spades), Spades (bid and bury), Euchre (right and left bowers, partner across the table).

Patience: Klondike Solitaire — stock, foundations, tableaus, the classic.

Two-player strategy: Cribbage (pegging, your fifteens, his nibs) and Gin Rummy (sets, runs, knock when you're under ten).

Shedding: Crazy Eights — match by rank or suit, eights are wild, first to empty their hand wins.

One unified launcher: swipe up/down to choose, tap to start. Every game obeys the same gesture grammar so muscle memory transfers — swipe to navigate the cursor, tap to play, double-tap to advance through end-of-hand and end-of-game screens. The phone view mirrors the glasses display and provides per-game settings (difficulty, target score) plus a New game / Back to menu button for when you want to bail out between hands.

Three difficulty tiers across every game where it makes sense (Easy / Medium / Hard), so the same app grows with you.

Hands-free. No microphone. No internet required. AI plays at full speed when it's not your turn.
